name: comp-300
title: Custom Sonner Toast
description: A small outline button that opens a custom notification at the bottom of the screen. The toast shows a green tick, a short confirmation, then View and Undo links and a close icon.
use: You need to confirm an action and offer a quick undo or detail link without blocking the page.
avoid: It needs a toast host and a third-party toast library mounted, so it does not work as a lone file.
a11y: Close carries an aria-label and icons are hidden from screen readers, but the code does not account for reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark, rounded toast strip sits low on the stage: a green circled tick, the words Message sent, then View and Undo links split by a dot, and an X at the right edge. A small outlined button labelled Custom sonner floats at the top left.
behaves: Clicking the trigger raises the toast from the bottom. It fades away on its own after a short pause, or at once when Undo or the X is pressed; the action links underline on hover.
customise: The trigger label and the toast text, icon and actions are written in the file; the toast width comes from a CSS variable on the host.
weight: light: A small button and one notification; the toast library handles showing and hiding it.
